comparison.objective: Press a warped flange at its high spot; candidate fractures and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Localizing a high spot and applying sustained pressing force versus coaxial mandrel placement, transient hammer impact, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Only the flange-press title/task path is supplied; no deformation target, force threshold, or specs are available. Candidate has explicit fracture, retention, containment, and damage criteria.
comparison.reason: Pressing a warped flange tests localized quasi-static force application, not bimanual impact fracture at small insert notches.
